# fMRI

This page is a navigation point for the lab's fMRI resources. Scanner access, safety screening, acquisition, and data handling must follow the current rules of the imaging facility and the approved study protocol.

## Suggested topics

- Facility induction and scanner safety
- Participant screening and preparation
- Session planning and acquisition protocols
- Quality assurance and common artefacts
- Data transfer, organization, and preprocessing
- Relevant analysis pipelines and recommended reading
